newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Pacific Andes buys U.S. fish firm - paper.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Andes buys U.S. fish firm - paper.

text.p: Seafood trader Pacific Andes Holdings, due to reveal financial results for the year to March 31 on Monday, has agreed to buy 60 percent of U.S.-based National Fish and Seafoods Inc, the Business Times reported.

The deal, announced in the company's latest annual report, marks a further step in Pacific Andes' expansion plans giving it a ready-made network to penetrate the U.S. frozen seafood market, the newspaper said.
The report also said Pacific Andes had bought China-based processing and distribution firm Pelican Food Ltd, giving it a further foothold in the Chinese market.
The financial report gave no financial details of either deal, but said the company expected them to make a major contribution to its global expansion and new deals could follow.
Hong Kong-based Pacific Andes listed on the Stock Exchange of Singapore in October 1996, raising US$16.5 million. The shares stood at US$0.95 at Friday's close.
